test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: CJ 16 is related to DF 9 in a certain way. In the same way, FK 9 is related to GG 2. To which of the following is OO 2 related following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**For 'CJ 16' related to 'DF 9':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afc3240ada06e1d7ce942bb9bd12b15b8f29826550f1348d9ca9d9cf7d980ee8.png] 

**For 'FK 9' related to 'GG 2':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ba598a77dcdb40aeee046c5163973b5dcc555111cea0fd16855cbf035d6ea5.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **First letter +1, Second letter -4, Number -7**.

**Applying the same logic to 'OO 2':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8849560f814a3fd9665465155923297df8723e8d0925d3b8f9cf826c00ee1ea.png] 

Thus, 'OO 2' is related to **PK -5**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
